simple.summary: נִיד (nîyd) means motion (of the lips in speech) First listed occurrence: Job 16 5.

definitions.full: H5205. nid נִיד noun masculine :(see below) quivering motion of lips; — only construct ׳נ שְׂפָתַי Job 16:5 the motion of my lips (in expressing sympathy). — ᵑ0 makes subject of יחשׂך , but read probably אחשׂך , see חשׂך . נִידָה see נִדָּה below נדד .
